The option is disabled automatically in development, when `hashMode` is enabled, when a root-level catch-all page (such as `pages/[...slug].vue`) matches every path, and when a custom `app/router.options` file may modify `routes` (a file whose default export is a plain object without a `routes` key remains compatible).
+Treats the page routes as fixed once the app is built, which lets Nuxt skip work that only exists to support a route table that changes at runtime.
